files.freesoundName: Handling and opening a large brown paper padded envelope
files.description:
Handling and opening a large brown paper padded envelope from Amazon. Ripping the package open after handling it. Pulling out the items inside. Rustling items around. Setting items down on a desk. Crumpling the envelope.

Recorded in my studio on a Neumann TLM 103 microphone.
files.author: RavenWolfProds

files.description: Join me on an exciting journey: I select a large envelope from a stack of papers, take a pen out of a jar (pen clicking sounds in another clip), write on the envelope, rip open the envelope and remove the papers that are inside... then I shuffle those papers a bit and open a few that were folded.
